name: after-the-signal-mobile
description: Capacitor wrapper for the After the Signal prototype

scripts.add:android: npm run stage && cap add android && node tools/run_python.mjs tools/configure_native.py
scripts.add:ios: npm run stage && cap add ios && node tools/run_python.mjs tools/configure_native.py
scripts.sync: npm run stage && cap sync && node tools/run_python.mjs tools/configure_native.py
